latHint: Think a tasty offer you can't refuse - not fishing bait.
pivHint: A fisherman's LURE draws fish to the hook - but to LURE a person means to do what to them?
winText: Hook, line and sinker. LURE was the pivot - fishing bait to a TEMPTing offer.
lossText: TEMPT - to entice. LURE was the pivot: fishing LURE to LUREing someone in.
